simple.meaning: בְּלִימָה (bᵉlîymâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “(as indefinitely) nothing whatever.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H1099. belimah בְּלִימָה noun [masculine] nothingness (from בְּלִי & מָה , literally not-aught ) Job 26:7 who hangeth the earth on ׳בְּ .
